why: eHistoLab is a named bilingual virtual-microscopy learning platform that others could adopt, rather than a general instructional element.

why: This is a setting-specific six-session intervention design for Taiwanese adults with type 2 diabetes, combining eHealth instruction, hands-on training, and home practice rather than defining a reusable instructional element.
